diagnosis.root_cause: The billing-api deployment performed a breaking database schema migration (renaming invoices.amount to amount_cents) combined with code in a single release, causing old instances running during the rollout to fail invoice writes because the 'amount' column no longer exists.
evidence: 2026-11-17T22:00:00Z billing-api a7b8c9d rename invoices.amount -> amount_cents (migration + code in one release)
billing-api / schema_errors_per_s spiked from ~0 to ~30 starting at 22:02 UTC
2026-11-17T22:01:00Z billing-api ERROR old instances: column invoices.amount does not exist (SQLSTATE 42703); invoice writes failing
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Roll back the billing-api deployment to the previous stable version immediately to restore compatibility with the pre-migration schema, or complete the rollout if safe, but rolling back is standard for mixed-version schema incompatibility. Follow up by separating breaking database schema migrations from code deployments in the future (e.g., expand-and-contract pattern).
